events.text: Battle of Vienna: a Polish-led army breaks the Ottoman siege of Vienna.
Switzerland adopts a new constitution, becoming a federal state.
Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8 premieres in Munich.
Prehistoric cave paintings are discovered at Lascaux, France.
John F. Kennedy marries Jacqueline Bouvier in Newport, Rhode Island.
Jack Kilby demonstrates the first working integrated circuit.
The Soviet Union launches Luna 2 towards the Moon.
President Kennedy gives his "We choose to go to the Moon" speech at Rice University.
Emperor Haile Selassie of Ethiopia is deposed.
Mae Jemison becomes the first African-American woman in space aboard Space Shuttle Endeavour.
